name: @goondocks/myco-collective
description: Myco Collective worker, admin UI, and deployment CLI

scripts.postinstall: test -d ui && cd ui && npm install || true
scripts.build: sh -c 'npm run build:core & pid1=$!; npm run build:ui & pid2=$!; wait $pid1; s1=$?; wait $pid2; s2=$?; test $s1 -eq 0 -a $s2 -eq 0'
scripts.build:ui: test -d ui && cd ui && npx vite build
scripts.dev:ui: test -d ui && cd ui && npx vite dev
scripts.test: echo 'myco-collective tests run from repo root'
